title: Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference Guest Speech Review p04 Shengqu Games Chen Shuyu Designing with Software Features for Flat Characters
description:
Thank you to all the guests for their wonderful speeches and valuable insights at the Marvelous Designer 2025 Shanghai User Conference!

In this conference, we delved into the powerful appeal of Marvelous Designer in game development and virtual creation. The presentations covered practical tips for designing game character costumes, as well as a special discussion on how Marvelous Designer interacts with Unreal Engine to enhance the realism of virtual clothing, culminating in the stunning release of new features for 2025 and the shared growth between Marvelous Designer and its users.

Don't miss out on these exciting contents!
